messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We have detected security issues on behalf your account, in order to use eBay in the future you have to download and install the eBay Security Shield by following these steps:', 'Mailbox Sending/Receiving authentication will be disabled at 500 MB', 'Due to routine maintenance and enhancements, the following programs or systems access will not be available for use on Wednesday, September 06, 2017, from 6pm.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'WE SELL ONLY GENUINE EARTHLING RDP NO SMTP NEEDED', 'We would like to notify you that Lloyds carries out client details confirmation procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
